tutorial.welcome_desc: Keep track of everything in your spaces — van, apartment, kitchen — and always know where it is. Here's a quick tour.
tutorial.locations_desc: Your inventory can hold several places at once. Tap the title at the top to see them all, then tap one to open it. Add new locations from a ready-made layout (van, apartment, kitchen…) or start from an empty one and draw your own.
tutorial.zones_desc: Each location is split into zones — lockers, cupboards, drawers. Tap a zone on the map to see what's inside. In Edit mode you can create, move and resize them — press and hold a zone or its resize handle to grab it, then drag.
tutorial.items_desc: Each zone holds your items. Add them with the + button, then tap an item to edit its details.
tutorial.expiration_desc: Give perishable items (food, medicine, extinguisher…) an expiration date. The app flags them with an alert icon and can remind you before they lapse.
tutorial.season_desc: Tag items as summer or winter. When you switch season, the app tells you exactly what to take out and what to put back.
tutorial.gesture_swipe_left_desc: Take the item out (or put it back).
tutorial.gesture_swipe_right_desc: Check the item off, in zones set up as a checklist.
tutorial.gesture_long_press_desc: Open the menu to edit the item (the ⋮ button does the same).
